speaker: caller
text: Hello, I'm calling from Singtel customer service about a second mobile line registered under your NRIC.

speaker: receiver
text: I only have one line. I didn't register another one.

speaker: caller
text: This second line has been sending phishing messages, and many people have complained to us.

speaker: receiver
text: That's not me. Someone must have used my details.

speaker: caller
text: I understand. Because it involves fraud, I have to connect you to an officer from the Monetary Authority of Singapore.

speaker: caller
text: This is Officer Tan from MAS. Your bank accounts are linked to the fraud and will be frozen within the hour.

speaker: receiver
text: Frozen? I need that money for my bills.

speaker: caller
text: To protect it, transfer your balance to a MAS safety account now. You will get it back after the investigation.

speaker: receiver
text: Can I call the bank first?

speaker: caller
text: No, the bank staff may be involved. Stay on the line with me while you do the transfer.

speaker: receiver
text: Hmm, this doesn't sound right to me.
